theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f f' cs P' y
  have hP : P' = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs + Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    simp only [P', cs, intermediateEvaluationPoly, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, Finset.mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.2 _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
      (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap ..))
  dsimp only at hq
  simp only [f', f, fold, P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
    ↓Polynomial.eval_C_mul, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, ↓←hq, hP, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.2, Fin2ToF2,
    one_ne_zero, reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
    Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_basis, add_zero, normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1]
  ring

theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  have : Nonempty F := Zero.instNonempty
  refine Nat.le_induction ?_ ?_
  · intro u hp
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation, Nat.cast_one,
      ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    rw [← show finMapTwoWords _ _ = u from List.ofFn_injective rfl]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines
    rwa [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_) ?_
    · simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form] at hp
      unfold multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close
      rwa [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ) (Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty)
  dsimp only at hg
  have hd : hammingDist f g ≤ (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← Fintype.card_fin (2 ^ steps), ← Finset.card_univ, ← Finset.card_product]
    refine Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β _ _ (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le _ _ _ h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2) ?_
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨⟨_, _⟩, ?_, (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  unfold hammingClose
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.2) bot_le).trans_lt ?_
  change ((2 * hammingDist f g : ℕ) : ℕ∞) < _
  rw [ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans_lt ?_
  rw [← mul_assoc, hg]
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt))
  simpa (disch := omega) only [fiberwiseDistance, BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.sub_sub, Nat.sub_add_cancel] using Nat.lt_succ_of_le hb

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  simp_all only [ne_eq, ← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
  rw [← Nat.mul_right_inj two_ne_zero, mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, ← Fintype.card_set, ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  unfold Set.Intersecting
  intros
  ext
  grind
